line 2 ("And gazing up into the firmament")
findings.source_quote: And gazing up into the firmament
findings.suggested_fix: Translate "firmament" with a neutral, standard Hindi term for the sky/heavens (e.g., "नभ" or "आकाश"), not "तप्त नभ". Keep the surrounding punctuation/HTML exactly as in the translation. Example replacement: "और नभ की ओर ऊपर ताकते हो" or "और आकाश की ओर ऊपर ताकते हो".
findings.translation_quote: और तप्त नभ में ऊपर ताकते हो

lines 6–7 ("Or can you see the distances so great / Which stretch the mind almost to breaking point / And make you feel the size you really are?")
findings.source_quote:
Or can you see the distances so great
Which stretch the mind almost to breaking point
And make you feel the size you really are?
findings.suggested_fix: Render "make you feel the size you really are" to convey the poet's intended sense of human smallness/insignificance rather than physical "stature". For example: "और तुम्हें तुम्हारी असल हीन-सी छोटाई/नन्हापन का अहसास कराती हैं?" or "और तुम्हें अपनी असल छोटी-सी प्रवृत्ति/अपनी सूक्ष्मता का अहसास कराती हैं?" Preserve line breaks and HTML tags.
findings.translation_quote:
या क्या तुम उन अत्यंत दूरस्थ दूरीों को देख पाते हो
जो विचार को लगभग तोड़ देती हैं
और तुम्हें तुम्हारी असली कद-काठी का अहसास कराती हैं?

lines 11–12 ("That tiny sphere so very close at hand.")
findings.source_quote: That tiny sphere so very close at hand.
findings.suggested_fix: "sphere" here refers to the moon as a small spherical body. Replace "नन्हे गोल धब्बे" (which reads as 'spot') with a word that conveys a small sphere, e.g. "उस छोटे गोले तक" or "उस छोटे गोले तक जो बहुत नज़दीक था". Preserve surrounding punctuation/HTML.
findings.translation_quote: उस नन्हे गोल धब्बे तक जो हाथ के बहुत पास था.
